decision.reasoning_trace: I am searching for a reliable, mid-sized technical backpack for multi-day hiking. I narrowed my search down to five potential options, but none fully met my requirements. The premium models (Osprey Exos 58 and Granite Gear Virga 2) have concerning reviews regarding durability, specifically broken straps and flimsy suspension systems, which are deal-breakers for an expensive gear investment. The higher-capacity models (High Sierra 70L and Mardingtop 70L) are slightly larger than I need and have mixed reports on comfort and weight distribution. Finally, the Warrior tactical backpack is well-rated but more suited for 3-day assault scenarios than wilderness trekking. Given that a large portion of the remaining feed consisted of unrelated accessories like towels and lanterns rather than technical packs, I have decided not to make a purchase during this session.
